TEXT:
[FI] I left the building and went straight for where 
Ayase was waiting, shaking my head.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...No good. They're all booked up.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] I see...

[FI] Ayase looked up at the dark cloudy sky. It was 
raining heavily outside, accompanied with strong 
gusty winds.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] Even the trains won't leave. They say the weather 
will get worse...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...We have to find somewhere to stay.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...Yes.

[FI] Apparently, a typhoon was drawing near. And a 
pretty big one, meaning we would soon find 
ourselves in the middle of the storm.

[FI] Due to the weather conditions, all public 
transportation had stopped and as tourists flooded 
the hotels, they quickly ran out of rooms.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] But we still can't find somewhere to stay...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Actually, I asked around and there might just be a 
place. Want to take a look?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Really?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I couldn't get any confirmation, but checking it out 
is better than just standing here.

[FI] Besides, we're both going to catch a cold if we 
stand around here much longer.

[FI] After that, we managed to get a room to stay... Well, 
honestly I'm kind of worried whether this worn-out 
Japanese inn can stand against the strong winds.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] It's a good thing we found a vacant room, isn't it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] It sure is.
[FI] We were both soaked to the bone.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...We'll catch a cold like this.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I guess. We should take a bath before that 
happens...

[FI] The rain and wind were still loud outside the 
windows. The news had said the storm would pass 
during the evening, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] It doesn't seem to be calming down...

[FI] Ayase was sitting next to me, smiling awkwardly. I 
was probably also stuck with a pretty awkward 
expression.

[FI] What was supposed to have been a day trip had 
now turned into a trip over a day and a night. It's 
pretty natural to be nervous here...
[FI] Still, Ayase is really cute in a yukata. Seriously.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] It'd be nice if the typhoon passes quickly.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] I-It would.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] And it seems the train isn't back up and running yet 
either.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Y-Yeah...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] Ah! It's rare that we're at a Japanese inn, we just 
have to eat some steamed buns!

[FI] Maybe she couldn't take any more of this awkward 
conversation, since she spoke up in a conspicuously 
bright voice.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Ah, this is surprisingly good!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...I guess I'll have one too.

[FI] Going with the flow, I took a steamed bun... Huh? 
Doesn't this taste kind of strange?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] That reminds me, the bath was pretty big, wasn't 
it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I guess it was. Though it was still pretty worn-out.

[FI] Ayase was quickly stuffing her mouth with the 
steamed buns. I guess she's still a bit nervous.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] Still, it feels good to be able to stretch your legs in 
the bath.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] And since there weren't any other guests, it was as 
if we reserved the entire bath.

[FI] Ayase's body suddenly started to sway for a 
moment.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] H-Huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hey, are you okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Y-Yes... It's nothing...

[FI] Ayase smiled as she replied... and her head fell on 
my shoulder.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] H-Hey...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Um, Onii-san...
[FI] Her eyes were half-closed.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Can you... hold my hand?
[FI] Her face was completely flushed.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] S-Sure, I don't mind...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] I'm feeling all hot... It just has to be your fault, 
Onii-san.
[FI] Even her yukata was worn-out...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] Onii-san, your heart is also beating really fast, isn't it? 
I can feel it through your hand...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Want to... check my pulse...

[FI] W-Wait! ...Does she mean... that?! My body is not 
ready...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] H-Hey, let's stop joking around now.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Hey, aren't you going to check...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Onii-san...

[FI] Her breath was brushing against my face. Her 
clouded eyes took a hold of my confused heart.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] A-Ayase!

[FI] I made up my mind and turned to look into her 
eyes...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Ayase?

[FI] Ayase had fallen asleep with her head on my 
shoulder with an intoxicated expression on her face.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ayase? Ayase-san~? ...She's sound asleep?

[FI] Suddenly curious, I checked the wrapping paper 
on the remaining buns.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Sake buns...? So thanks to these, Ayase...

[FI] I suddenly felt all my energy drain from my body. 
Haha, yeah, that's it...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] G-Good morning...

[FI] The next morning, Ayase was back to normal... No 
actually, she might be even more nervous now than 
yesterday.

[FI] She seems to remember some parts of last night, 
but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Looks like the typhoon has passed.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Y-Yes, it has.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Let's go home, shall we?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Yes...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Um, Onii-san?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] W-What is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] N-No, it's nothing...

[FI] Even after we got back, there was this 
awkwardness between us.

[FI] On the other hand, Ayase had been so erotic last 
night...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Okay, I'm going this way, so...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I'll walk you home.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] No... I'm fine from here.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Alright. Be careful on your way home.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] You too, Onii-san... I'll call you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Sure.

[FI] I stood there looking after her until she 
disappeared from my view.
[FI] And so the curtains closed on our first trip together.
